rules.sentence: The diagnosis is made by finding a microangiopathic hemolytic anemia in the context of the characteristic clinical picture.
An assay for ADAMTS13 activity is available using an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay but the initiation of treatment usually cannot await confirmation of the diagnosis.
The recommended treatment for TTP is plasma exchange or plasma infusion.
In most patients who survive, recovery of the focal neurologic deficits can be expected unless there is an identifiable infarction on CT or MRI.
